correctness.rationale: The proof derives all statements from the valuation filtration of a finite chain ring. Exact degree separation proves layer invariance; same-layer permutations give the complete automorphism group; twin classes force both lower bounds; and an explicit valuation-layer witness proves the resolving upper bound.
